content: Macadamia oil, also known as macadamia nut oil, is a non-volatile oil extracted from the nut meat of the macadamia tree, scientifically named Macadamia integrifolia. This oil is utilized in culinary applications, such as frying or as a salad oil, and in cosmetic formulations where it serves as an emollient or a fragrance fixative. Chemically, macadamia oil is composed of approximately 60% oleic acid, 19% palmitoleic acid, 1-3% linoleic acid, and 1-2% linolenic acid. Some varieties of the oil exhibit a nearly balanced ratio of omega-6 to omega-3 fatty acids. Despite being cultivated in diverse regions globally, the fatty acid composition of macadamia oil remains relatively consistent and is not significantly affected by environmental factors. The oil exhibits the chemical characteristics typical of a vegetable triglyceride oil and is highly stable due to its low content of polyunsaturated fats. Physically, macadamia oil is a liquid at room temperature. The refined version of the oil is clear and has a light amber hue, accompanied by a subtle nutty aroma. While it can be further refined to achieve complete transparency, the faint scent of macadamia nuts typically persists. In food applications, macadamia oil is highly valued as a frying oil because of its excellent heat tolerance. Key attributes that make it suitable as an edible oil include its high monounsaturated fat content (up to 85%), a shelf life of one to two years without refrigeration, and a smoke point of 410°F. In the realm of cosmetics, macadamia oil is prized for its rich, cushiony texture on the skin and its high oxidative stability, making it particularly well-suited for use in heavy creams and sun care products. Cosmetic derivatives of macadamia oil include Ethyl Macadamiate, a lightweight emollient, and PEG-16 Macadamia Glycerides, which are water-soluble. Macadamia oil is also an excellent botanical alternative to mink oil in various applications. Its International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients (INCI) designation is Macadamia Integrifolia Seed Oil.
